name: EOSE WP-MVP-0002 Start Bootstrap

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - eose/start-wp-mvp-0002-bootstrap

permissions:
  contents: write

env:
  EOS_ACTOR: thomascarter613

jobs:
  start:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30
    steps:
      - name: Checkout bootstrap branch
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Enter exact final-tree baseline
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -Eeuo pipefail
          BASE_SHA="3c48a6ac5e3fc994b83cde39799faed138e6c036"
          test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$GITHUB_SHA"
          git fetch origin main
          test "$(git rev-parse origin/main)" = "$BASE_SHA"
          git reset --hard "$BASE_SHA"
          test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$BASE_SHA"
          test ! -e .github/workflows/eose-start-wp-mvp-0002-bootstrap.yml
          test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"

      - name: Start WP-MVP-0002
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -Eeuo pipefail
          ./scripts/eos start WP-MVP-0002
          ./scripts/eos status
          ./scripts/eos next

      - name: Refresh WP-MVP-0001 evidence for final semantic source set
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -Eeuo pipefail
          ./scripts/eos validate WP-MVP-0001 --profile wp

      - name: EOS verification and projection stabilization
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -Eeuo pipefail
          ./scripts/eos verify --strict
          ./scripts/eos state status
          python3 scripts/sync-machine-docs.py --write
          python3 scripts/sync-machine-docs.py --check

      - name: Assert start invariants and scope
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -Eeuo pipefail
          python3 - <<'PY'
          from pathlib import Path
          import csv, json

          wp = Path('engineering/work-packets/WP-MVP-0002.md').read_text()
          assert '**Status:** IN_PROGRESS' in wp, wp.splitlines()[:8]

          with Path('.eos/work-packets.tsv').open(newline='') as fh:
              rows = {row['id']: row for row in csv.DictReader(fh, delimiter='\t')}
          row = rows['WP-MVP-0002']
          assert row['status'] == 'IN_PROGRESS', row
          assert row['pi'] == 'PI-MVP-001', row
          assert row['wc'] == 'WC-MVP-0001', row

          events = [json.loads(line) for line in Path('.eos/events.jsonl').read_text().splitlines() if line.strip()]
          starts = [e for e in events if e.get('target') == 'WP-MVP-0002' and e.get('action') == 'start' and e.get('event_type') == 'STATE_TRANSITION']
          assert len(starts) == 1, starts
          start = starts[0]
          assert start['from_state'] == 'AUTHORIZED' and start['to_state'] == 'IN_PROGRESS', start
          assert start['commit'] == '3c48a6ac5e3fc994b83cde39799faed138e6c036', start
          assert start['reason'] == 'authorized execution started', start

          with Path('.eos/evidence.tsv').open(newline='') as fh:
              evidence = list(csv.DictReader(fh, delimiter='\t'))
          current = [r for r in evidence if r.get('target') == 'WP-MVP-0001' and r.get('status') != 'SUPERSEDED']
          assert len(current) == 3, current
          assert {r['validator'] for r in current} == {'eos-integrity', 'repository', 'execution-acceptance'}, current
          assert all(r['status'] == 'VALIDATED' for r in current), current
          assert all(r['result'] in {'PASSED', 'SKIPPED'} for r in current), current
          assert all(int(r['id'].split('-')[1]) > 15 for r in current), current
          PY

          if git diff --name-only | grep -E '^(crates/|src/|.*\.rs$|engineering/work-cycles/WC-MVP-0001\.md$|\.github/workflows/)'; then
            echo 'Unexpected implementation, parent-cycle, or workflow change detected.' >&2
            exit 1
          fi
          git status --short
          git diff --stat
          git diff -- engineering/work-packets/WP-MVP-0002.md
          git diff -- .eos/work-packets.tsv
          git diff -- .eos/evidence.tsv

      - name: Commit, prove stable, and publish isolated final ref
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -Eeuo pipefail
          FINAL_BRANCH="eose/start-wp-mvp-0002"
          git config user.name 'PMB CI'
          git config user.email 'ci@pmb.test'
          git add -A
          if git diff --cached --name-only | grep -E '^(crates/|src/|.*\.rs$|engineering/work-cycles/WC-MVP-0001\.md$|\.github/workflows/)'; then
            echo 'Unexpected out-of-scope changes staged.' >&2
            exit 1
          fi
          git diff --cached --stat
          git commit -m 'chore(eose): start WP-MVP-0002'

          ./scripts/eos verify --strict
          ./scripts/eos state status
          python3 scripts/sync-machine-docs.py --check
          test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"
          test "$(git rev-parse HEAD^)" = "3c48a6ac5e3fc994b83cde39799faed138e6c036"

          if git ls-remote --exit-code --heads origin "$FINAL_BRANCH" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
            echo "Final publication branch already exists: $FINAL_BRANCH" >&2
            exit 1
          fi
          git push origin "HEAD:refs/heads/$FINAL_BRANCH"
